title: Offline AWG decision request and consumption binding
rules: A material alternative is escalated with a stable batch ID and digest-only context.
A consumed decision must be attributed to AWG and bound to the exact request, task revision, and session.
Guidance references are opaque IDs and digests; runtime cannot author them.
An absent, rejected, conflicting, stale, or expired decision blocks the material alternative.
Runtime must not silently select an alternative or manufacture approval.

failure_semantics.side_effects: No AWG, network, LLM, provider, Coordinator, UI, Git, or durable-state operation is performed.

limitations: A passing fixture is deterministic structural qualification only.
It is not a live AWG response or a production approval.
Live transport and durable decision persistence require separately authorized integration.
